about: Every API route the pages of the browser suite's visual review read (packages/dispatch/e2e/visual.e2e.ts), as the route table writes it, every kind of live view they subscribe on GET /ws/live, and every sign-in route they read (the routes package's /auth routes). The visual rows share one seeded corpus and stop every write their pages send (packages/dispatch/e2e/visual-guard.ts); a write the server makes while answering one of these reads or views is held to the tables it may write by TestTheVisualShotReadsWriteOnlyTheirCaches (visual_shot_reads_test.go). A visual row fails on a read whose route, a subscribe whose view kind, or a sign-in read whose path this list does not name, so a page that comes to read a new one adds it here, and a path, view or call for it to that test.
